comment: Packages whose .deb is only on a GitHub release, not in debs/. scripts/release-packages.py downloads each url in the build, checks its size and sha256 against this list (the build fails otherwise), indexes it beside debs/, and sets its Filename to the url. The package's fields come from the .deb itself. Add a version by its release asset; keep the old ones listed while they are still on the source.
